pr_body:
See individual commits

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/45622

There are still several outstanding things that should have some attention, most related to `bt_codec`, and whether it should be `bt_audio_codec` or stay as `bt_codec`, but be moved from `audio.h`. 

Note for reviewers: I suggest to keep your focus at the public API files. There are no functionality changes, and the changes in all files are merely renames.

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Update BAP API with new naming scheme
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
Apply the new naming scheme from https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/40920 to the MICP implemenation and API.

For BAP it will mostly be to omit the `bt_audio` prefix as well as splitting audio.h into role-specific files, and probably also creating a stream.h 

All values related to generic audio assigned numbers, etc. can remain in audio.h 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
N/A

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Additional context**
N/A
comments: We will use MICP as the pilot for this change in https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/45558 as that is by far the simplest profile. Once we have agreed on the details, we can use that to complete this issue;

review_comments: Did the formatting rules change? There seem to be quite a few re-indentation/line break diffs in this PR (probably fine)

> Did the formatting rules change? There seem to be quite a few re-indentation/line break diffs in this PR (probably fine)

Yes, the TSC recently changes the column width from 80 (recommended) and 100 (maximum) to just being 100 (maximum). Any such line changes has been done by `clang-format` in this PR, and I'll be happy to switch them back if requested
Something looks a bid odd on the auto-formatting here
Hmm, besides `clang-format` adding the `\` it doesn't seem odd to me.
do we use spaces like "{ 0 }" or no spaces (as done here)? (I thought either one or the other would be caught by the compliance check
I expect that the change from `{ 0 }` to `{0}` was done by `clang-format`. I can revert that. I don't believe we have any guidelines for this though.
